scope: Capability audit only; no production repair or R0.3 implementation

classificationDefinitions.KEEP: Observable behavior is correct, behavior-tested, production-wired, and aligned with target authority.
classificationDefinitions.REPAIR: A useful foundation is retained but bounded gaps remain.
classificationDefinitions.REPLACE: The implementation or authority model is incompatible with the rebuild target, absent behind an overclaim, or unsafe to evolve in place.
classificationDefinitions.DELETE: Dead, accidental, duplicate, or misleading material with no target role.
classificationDefinitions.ARCHIVE: Historical evidence only; it must not remain active authority.

summary.keepPolicy: No subsystem is KEEP: passing pure-function tests do not establish production wiring, durable authority, calibrated behavior, or target-architecture fit.

crossCuttingRisks.secretLeakage: No explicit raw-secret persistence path is present, but sanitization cannot redact an accidentally passed secret, mock metadata stores full URLs, and no tests prove non-leakage.
crossCuttingRisks.ssrf: HTTPS/origin/path checks exist, but private/link-local/loopback IPs, DNS rebinding and resolved-address policy are not controlled.
crossCuttingRisks.redirect: fetch redirect:error is declared; untested and no provider calls the transport.
crossCuttingRisks.symlink: Leaf symlinks are checked with lstat before existence, which can throw; parent symlinks and TOCTOU swaps remain; realpathSync is unused.
crossCuttingRisks.permissions: Directory and credential modes are checked, but terms/spec/audit file ownership/modes and safe creation are not enforced.
crossCuttingRisks.rawPayloadPersistence: Audit code intends digest-only storage; no provider exists, and response.text buffers the full payload before the post-read size check.
crossCuttingRisks.quota: Only a process-local fixed-window counter exists; restart/multi-process bypass and provider headers/backoff are absent.
crossCuttingRisks.duplicate: Comments claim payload duplicate suppression, but no provider/cache implementation exists.
crossCuttingRisks.staleness: Constants/reason codes exist, but no payload mapper/provider applies them.
crossCuttingRisks.fallback: Comments prohibit fixture fallback; no integration path exists to verify failure behavior.
